title: A fast talker (speed 1.15 to 1.2) with brief mid-turn pauses

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Hi, thanks for calling. How can I help?

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Hi, quick one, I need to push my appointment back by a week <1s> and I also want to double check the address.

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Sure. Pushing it back a week puts it on the fourteenth at the same time. Shall I do that?

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Yes, do that, <1.2s> and the address is the one on Market Street, right?

items.speaker: agent
items.text: That's right, it is the Market Street branch, on the second floor. Anything else you need?

items.speaker: caller
items.text: One more, can I get the confirmation by text, <1.1s> and the reminder too, <1.3s> both by text?

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Both by text, done. The confirmation is going out now and the reminder will come the day before. Anything else?
